events.title: US executive order establishes a digital-assets working group and changes federal policy
events.summary: A US executive order established the President's Working Group on Digital Asset Markets, directed review of federal digital-asset rules, called for recommendations on a federal framework, and prohibited agencies from establishing or promoting a US central bank digital currency except as required by law.
events.significance: The order marked a major change in US executive-branch digital-asset policy and set up later 2025 reserve and regulatory actions.

sources.title: White House — Strengthening American Leadership in Digital Financial Technology

events.title: El Salvador amends its Bitcoin Law and makes private acceptance voluntary
events.summary: El Salvador's legislature approved Decree 199 on 29 January 2025, amending the Bitcoin Law. The reform removed mandatory acceptance, removed Bitcoin's characterization as currency in the law, required state monetary obligations to be paid in their contracted currencies, and took effect 90 days after publication.
events.significance: The change materially scaled back key legal-tender features of El Salvador's 2021 Bitcoin experiment while leaving voluntary private use possible.

events.title: Bybit suffers a roughly $1.5 billion cold-wallet theft
events.summary: Attackers compromised a Bybit Ethereum cold-wallet transaction flow and stole about $1.46 billion in ETH and liquid-staking assets.
events.significance: The theft was the largest publicly reported crypto heist at the time and a major operational-security failure at a top centralized exchange.

sources.title: Bybit — Security Incident Timeline and FAQs

events.title: FBI attributes the Bybit theft to North Korea
events.summary: The FBI attributed the Bybit theft to North Korea, identifying the malicious activity as TraderTraitor and stating that approximately $1.5 billion in virtual assets had been stolen.
events.significance: The attribution connected crypto's largest reported theft to state-linked cyber operations and reinforced North Korea's role in crypto-security history.

sources.title: FBI — North Korea Responsible for $1.5 Billion Bybit Hack

events.title: United States establishes a Strategic Bitcoin Reserve
events.summary: A US executive order established a Strategic Bitcoin Reserve initially capitalized with finally forfeited government Bitcoin and stated that Bitcoin deposited in the reserve should not be sold, subject to the order and applicable law.
events.significance: The policy reversed the historical pattern of disposing of seized Bitcoin through auctions and created an explicit federal reserve category for government-owned BTC.

sources.title: White House — Establishment of the Strategic Bitcoin Reserve and United States Digital Asset Stockpile

events.title: United States establishes a separate Digital Asset Stockpile
events.summary: The same executive order created a United States Digital Asset Stockpile for finally forfeited government digital assets other than Bitcoin.
events.significance: The order explicitly separated Bitcoin reserve treatment from stewardship of other government-owned digital assets.

sources.title: White House — Strategic Bitcoin Reserve and Digital Asset Stockpile

events.title: BlackRock's BUIDL tokenized fund passes $1 billion AUM
events.summary: Securitize announced that BlackRock's BUIDL tokenized liquidity fund had surpassed $1 billion in assets under management.
events.significance: The milestone demonstrated that tokenized Treasury/cash-like products on public blockchains had grown beyond experimental scale.

events.title: BUIDL expands to Solana
events.summary: BlackRock and Securitize launched a BUIDL share class on Solana, extending the tokenized fund across seven supported blockchain networks.
events.significance: The expansion illustrated how institutional tokenization was becoming multi-chain rather than confined to Ethereum.

sources.title: Securitize — BUIDL Share Class on Solana

events.title: Ethereum activates Pectra
events.summary: Ethereum activated the Prague-Electra (Pectra) upgrade at epoch 364,032. Major changes included EIP-7702 account functionality, validator-balance changes and higher blob throughput.
events.significance: Pectra materially improved wallet programmability, validator operations and layer-2 scaling capacity.

events.title: US GENIUS Act becomes law
events.summary: The President signed S. 1582, the Guiding and Establishing National Innovation for U.S. Stablecoins Act, into law on 18 July 2025, establishing a federal framework for payment stablecoins.
events.significance: The law was a major US federal legislative milestone for stablecoin issuance and regulation.

sources.title: White House — President Signed S. 1582 into Law

events.title: SEC permits in-kind creations and redemptions for crypto ETPs
events.summary: The SEC approved orders allowing authorized participants in crypto-asset ETPs to create and redeem shares in kind rather than using only cash.
events.significance: The change aligned spot Bitcoin and Ether ETP mechanics more closely with traditional commodity ETP structures.

sources.title: SEC — Permits In-Kind Creations and Redemptions for Crypto ETPs

events.title: Corporate Bitcoin treasury strategies expand beyond early adopters
events.summary: More public companies adopted or expanded Bitcoin treasury strategies during 2025, while Strategy raised large amounts of capital and ended the year holding 713,502 BTC according to its annual report.
events.significance: Corporate Bitcoin accumulation evolved from a few isolated adopters into a distinct capital-markets strategy.
events.notes: Context node; individual treasury-company launches can be separate events if card-worthy.

events.title: Ethereum activates Fusaka and PeerDAS
events.summary: Ethereum activated the Fulu-Osaka (Fusaka) upgrade at epoch 411,392. Its headline feature, PeerDAS, distributed blob data-availability work and enabled further scaling of rollup data throughput.
events.significance: Fusaka represented another major step in Ethereum's rollup-centric scaling roadmap after Dencun and Pectra.
